$description: Spacing tokens — based on inferred layout proportions from edition_1 page templates

1.$description: Micro spacing; tight gutters and icon padding

3.$description: Caption-to-image gap and compact list items

4.$description: Base unit; paragraph spacing and component padding

7.$description: Section break and large vertical rhythm

8.$description: Page margin and hero section padding

9.$description: Full-bleed section offset and editorial white space

10.$description: Cover layout anchor and oversized decorative gap

margin.$description: Outer page margin on all sides

gutter.$description: Column gutter within a multi-column layout

zones.$description: Proportional layout zones inferred from patterns across all edition_1 practice pages. Heights are expressed as decimal fractions of the total page height (reference canvas: 800×1120px). The prompt zone is nested within the content zone — the two are not additive. Non-overlapping zones (header + content + effect + footer) account for approximately 71% of page height; the remainder is outer margins and inter-zone gaps.

height.$description: Header band zone height as a fraction of page height (9%; ≈ 100px on the 1120px canvas). Contains the distressed display title and subtitle. Consistent across all 10 practice pages.

Central content zone height as a fraction of page height (45%; ≈ 504px on the 1120px canvas). Contains the focal silhouette or imagery plus surrounding visual layers. Dominant visual region of every practice page. The prompt zone is positioned within this region.

Practice/prompt panels zone height as a fraction of page height (30%; ≈ 336px on the 1120px canvas). Contains the four labelled instruction panels arranged around the central figure. Nested within the content zone — do not add to content height when computing total layout height.

Effect band height as a fraction of page height (10%; ≈ 112px on the 1120px canvas). A highlighted strip summarising the neurological or emotional benefit of the practice. Present on all practice pages.

Footer/closing-banner zone height as a fraction of page height (7%; ≈ 78px on the 1120px canvas). Contains the bold affirming closing statement. Examples: 'NOTHING IS REQUIRED RIGHT NOW', 'INWARDNESS RESTORES CLARITY'.

inner_margin.$description: Inner margin applied between content blocks within a zone (panels, captions, nested elements). Corresponds to spacing.5 and keeps internal rhythm consistent across zones.
